controls.positive: the label-level rho agrees with the printed κ everywhere
controls.negative: the matter term of κ is needed

notes: κ recomputed from the root datum's roots and the representation's weights with the datum's pairing; labels compared after Weyl canonicalisation (fold).

checks.name: eq:rho-witten  rho(m,e) = (-m, κ(m) - e) with κ(m) = Σ_(α:<α,m>>0) <α,m> α (pure gauge; Weyl-canonical labels) on 155 labels of SU(2), SO(3), SU(3), Sp(4), G2
eq:rho-witten with matter  κ(m) carries -Σ <w,m> w and the flavour shifts by κ_f(m) = -D(m) w_f (f -> f^* ⊗ det^-D, in the diagonal U(1) of U(n_f)) on 261 labels of four (G, N)
eq:rhotorus  (rho f)_-m(v) = v^κ(m) f_m(v^-1) on the torus images of five SU(2) lines, every magnetic sector
eq:rhotorus with μ  (rho f)_-m(v, μ) = v^κ(m) μ^κ_f(m) f_m(v^-1, μ^-1) (κ with its matter term, κ_f(m) = -D(m)) on the torus images of four SU(2)+1 lines, every magnetic sector and μ-level
eq:rhotorus induces eq:rho-witten  chart(rho(a)) == rho(chart(a)) on the five SU(2) and four SU(2)+1 lines
eq:rhotorus is an algebra automorphism  rho(x·y) == rho(x)·rho(y) on all 41 torus products of those lines
negative control: the torus formula without v -> v^-1 is detected on L_(2,1)
negative control: dropping the matter term from κ is detected on SU(2)+1 fundamental
